invariants: Each idempotency key is permanently bound to an exact (staffId, serviceId, canonical startTime) request and one booking ID, including after cancellation.
Simultaneous same-key/same-payload requests serialize with BEGIN IMMEDIATE and return one booking; exactly one response is marked replayed.
Reusing an idempotency key with a different payload throws IdempotencyKeyConflictError and does not mutate the database.
Different keys cannot create two active bookings for the same staff/time; the V1 partial unique index remains the final database constraint.
Atomic cancellation transitions an active booking only once; replay of the original booking key after cancellation returns the cancelled booking, never a new booking.
Canonical UTC 30-minute slots remain mandatory; variable-duration scheduling, cross-host distributed locking and external databases are out of scope.
SQLite busy-lock contention beyond the configured five-second timeout reports RESERVATION_BUSY without claiming success.
